brief_answer: We cannot guarantee plus or minus 0.1 % accuracy in writing prior to testing, nor can any equipment vendor guarantee regulatory approval for release testing. Diffuse reflectance NIR is the recommended technique for granulate moisture, but quantitative performance depends on matrix-specific chemometric calibration against primary laboratory data. Feasibility testing on your representative granulate is required to establish true predictive accuracy, and commercial pricing will be provided separately by our sales team.
